'''Trebek''' was a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] in [[43 ABY]]. Trebek was one of the senators that supported the [[New Jedi Order]] and gave information to the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Masters Council]] regarding [[PsiCor]] [[wallscope]]s.<ref name="abyss" />
